action.default: absent -> `speed` is used instead; both absent -> "command_'script' : missing action argument"; an unknown value -> "command_script : unknown parameter from 'action' argument"
action.source: app_command_interface.cpp:2844, 2848-2926 (W_ACTION="action" base_command_interface.hpp:81; W_END="end" :153, W_PLAY="play" :154, W_RECORD="record" :84, W_CANCEL="cancelrecord" :155, W_PAUSE="pause" :156, W_RESUME="resume" :164, W_FASTER="faster" :157, W_SLOWER="slower" :158, W_DEFAULT="default" :139, W_ACQUIRE="acquire" :322, W_RELEASE="release" :323, W_BIND="bind" :325)

value_docs.acquire: take the global lock (only with `lock global`)
value_docs.bind: make a key run a script when it is pressed, released or both: `key` names the key, `press` and `release` the scripts, `scope` how long the binding lasts
value_docs.cancelrecord: stop recording and throw the recording away
value_docs.default: run the script at its normal speed
value_docs.end: stop the running script and clear what it put on screen: texts, music and every non-permanent picture
value_docs.pause: hold the running script where it is
value_docs.record: start writing every command that follows into the file named by `filename`
value_docs.release: give the global lock back (only with `lock global`)
value_docs.resume: let a held script go on

filename.default: absent or empty with `action play` -> the line falls through to "command_script : unknown parameter from 'action' argument"
filename.doc: The script file to play, or the file to record into.
filename.notes: Sharp edge: the name is treated as a VARIABLE and evaluated only when it does NOT look like it already has a three-letter extension - the test is 'shorter than 4 characters, or the fourth character from the end is not a dot' (:2846-2847). On `action play` the file is looked for in the script folder and the folder it is found in becomes the script path used by later commands (:2852-2857).

key.default: absent -> inside a script started by a key binding, that key; anywhere else -> "bind: 'key' omitted outside a script started by a key binding - write 'key <key>', such as 'key SHIFT+KP_8'"; a token the engine cannot read -> "unknown key '<key>': write [CTRL+][KWIN+][SUPER+][SHIFT+][ALT+] then an SDL scancode name without SDL_SCANCODE_, such as SHIFT+KP_8; a joystick button or hat direction as BUTTON3 or HAT0_UP, no prefix and no _ALT (a binding serves both sets of the joystick's ini); or * for every key"
key.doc: The key, joystick button or hat direction that runs the scripts; left out inside a script a key started, that key.
key.notes: The modifiers are part of the key: SHIFT+KP_8 and KP_8 are two keys, each with its own bindings (src/uiModule/key_binding.cpp:165-177 @ 52568219).
key.value_domain: a key token, in any case: [CTRL+][KWIN+][SUPER+][SHIFT+][ALT+] then an SDL scancode name without SDL_SCANCODE_ (such as SHIFT+KP_8), the modifiers accepted in any order; a joystick button or hat direction as BUTTON<n> or HAT<n>_<UP|DOWN|LEFT|RIGHT>, with no modifier and no _ALT; or * for every key

lock.default: absent or any other value with `action acquire`/`action release` -> nothing happens and the command still reports SUCCESS
lock.doc: Takes or gives back the lock that keeps two scripts from running at once.
lock.notes: Only read on the `acquire` and `release` paths (:2876-2883); on every other action it is ignored.

value_docs.global: the one lock shared by every script

press.default: absent -> the key's press binding is left as it is; `press` and `release` both absent -> "bind: give 'press <script|->', 'release <script|->' or both"; a name found in neither directory -> "bind: no script '<name>' as given, in the running script's directory or in the scripts directory"
press.doc: The script to run when the key is pressed, or - for no script, so that the key does what it does by default.

value_docs.-: no script: the key does its own action

press.value_domain: a script name, evaluated as a variable unless it ends in a three-letter extension and looked for in the running script's directory or in the scripts directory; or -

release.default: absent -> the key's release binding is left as it is; `press` and `release` both absent -> "bind: give 'press <script|->', 'release <script|->' or both"; a name found in neither directory -> "bind: no script '<name>' as given, in the running script's directory or in the scripts directory"
release.doc: The script to run when the key is released, or - for no script, so that the key does what it does by default.
release.notes: The release that runs is the one bound to the key as it was PRESSED: press SHIFT+KP_8, let go of SHIFT, then of KP_8, and the release of SHIFT+KP_8 runs (src/uiModule/key_binding.cpp:113-118 @ 52568219). The same word is also a value of `action`, which gives the global lock back.

value_docs.-: no script: the key does its own action

release.value_domain: a script name, evaluated as a variable unless it ends in a three-letter extension and looked for in the running script's directory or in the scripts directory; or -

scope.default: absent -> global; any other word -> "bind: unknown scope '<scope>' - write global, script or once"
scope.doc: How long the binding lasts: until the next global binding, until the running script ends, or until it has run once.

value_docs.global: replace every binding of this key and event with this one (with key *, every key's bindings of that event); it stays until the next global binding
value_docs.once: stack it on the key's binding until it has run once, then remove it
value_docs.script: stack it on the key's binding until the running script ends, then remove it

speed.default: absent -> `action` must be given instead; an unknown value -> "command_script : unknown parameter from 'speed' argument"
speed.doc: Change how fast the running script goes, without an `action`.
speed.notes: Only read when no `action` is written: the action block always returns (:2926).

doc: Start, stop, pause or speed up a script, or record what is being done into a new script.
name: script
